Subject: Request for Tax Correction – Invoice MA-8022

Dear Accounts Receivable Team,

With reference to purchase order PO-2026-1022, invoice MA-8022 dated October 7, 2026, for a total amount of EUR 1,088.00, has been placed on hold.

The tax amount of EUR 408.00 appears to exceed 30% of the subtotal of EUR 680.00. Please confirm the correct tax amount applicable to this invoice, as the amount currently indicated appears inconsistent with the expected tax rate.

If the tax amount is incorrect, please issue a credit note and provide a corrected invoice.

Kind regards,
